title: Valdria
description: The modpack required to play on Valdria.
body: Welcome to the official modpack for the Valdria Minecraft server! This carefully curated pack is designed to add a refreshing twist to your vanilla Minecraft experience. Centered around the popular Origins mod, Valdria offers new ways to play with unique abilities and challenges tailored to different Origins. This modpack not only enhances gameplay with these features but also introduces new content and mechanics that keep the classic Minecraft feel while adding an extra layer of excitement.
